task: اعمل نظام تغيير الطقس ب زر معين واعمل 4 حالات للطقس\

findings.title: Lightning flash erases entire scene
findings.detail: gl.clear(COLOR_BUFFER_BIT) in renderWeather() wipes all rendered geometry (terrain, mobs, clouds) and replaces the scene with a solid white frame. Lightning should overlay the scene, not erase it.

findings.title: weatherManual is never reset, permanently disables auto-weather
findings.detail: Pressing M or clicking the button sets weatherManual=true with no code path to reset it to false. Automatic biome-based weather transitions are permanently disabled for the session.

findings.title: Storm state unreachable via automatic weather system
findings.detail: updateWeather() only randomly selects from clear/rain/snow. Storm can only be reached via manual cycling, making it never part of natural gameplay.

findings.title: Snow particle count silently increased from 160 to 240
findings.detail: Drops array expanded to 240 for storm support, but renderWeather uses drops.length for snow, silently increasing snow particles by 50%. May impact low-end device performance.

findings.title: weather.t not reset on manual cycle
findings.detail: cycleWeather() does not reset weather.t to 0. If weatherManual is ever re-enabled, the stale timer could immediately trigger an unwanted weather change.
